document_title.description: The agreement's title as printed at the top, e.g. 'LEASE AGREEMENT'

lease_date.description: The Lease Date from the Basic Lease Information, as YYYY-MM-DD

landlord.description: The landlord named in the Basic Lease Information

notice_address.description: The landlord's notice address as printed, lines joined with ', '

attention.description: The person named after 'Attention:' in the landlord's notice block

tenant.description: The tenant named in the Basic Lease Information

notice_address.description: The tenant's notice address as printed, lines joined with ', '

attention.description: The person named after 'Attention:' in the tenant's notice block

description.description: The premises description as written, e.g. whether it is the entire building or a suite

address.description: The street address of the premises, including city, state and ZIP

rentable_square_feet.description: The rentable square footage as a number, from the figure in parentheses

term_months.description: The length of the lease term in full calendar months

term_start_reference.description: What the term runs from, e.g. 'Commencement Date'

base_rent_schedule.description: The Base Rent table, one entry per row in order

period.description: The months of the term the row covers exactly as printed, e.g. 'Month 02 – Month 12'

start_month.description: The first month of the term the row covers

end_month.description: The last month of the term the row covers

monthly_base_rent.description: The monthly base rent for the period in dollars, ignoring footnote asterisks

rate_per_square_foot.description: The monthly rate per rentable square foot in dollars

rent_waiver_months.description: The number of full months for which monthly base rent is waived (the Rent Waiver Period), or 0 if none

permitted_use.description: The permitted use of the premises from the Use line

security_deposit.description: The security deposit amount in dollars

landlord_broker.description: The broker for the landlord, as printed
